environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application in namespace 'frontend-apps'. Istio service mesh with STRICT mTLS. An AuthorizationPolicy resource named 'deny-cross-namespace-raw' is applied to workloads in 'internal-services' namespace with spec.action DENY matching source.notNamespaces ['internal-services'] combined with a custom EnvoyFilter on the backend's inbound listener chain that normalizes ambiguous Transfer-Encoding headers (strips TE when CL is present) before the request reaches the application container. The AuthorizationPolicy uses a 'when' condition requiring request.headers[x-mesh-validated] to be present (injected only by same-namespace sidecars via a Lua filter). Additionally, PeerAuthentication in STRICT mode ensures only mTLS-authenticated traffic from authorized service accounts can reach the backend.

envoy_filter.name: normalize-te-headers
envoy_filter.patch: INBOUND listener filter - strips Transfer-Encoding when Content-Length present, applied at NETWORK_FILTER stage before HCM

config.network_policy: deny ingress from namespaces without label mesh-tier=internal
